sql: SELECT phone FROM customers WHERE contactLastName LIKE 'M%' AND country != 'Germany'
SELECT SUM(amount) / COUNT(customerNumber) FROM payments WHERE paymentDate >= '2004-01-01' AND paymentDate < '2004-07-01'
SELECT DISTINCT e.reportsTo FROM employees e JOIN customers c ON c.salesRepEmployeeNumber = e.employeeNumber WHERE c.country = 'France'
SELECT o.addressLine1, o.addressLine2 FROM customers c JOIN employees e ON c.salesRepEmployeeNumber = e.employeeNumber JOIN offices o ON o.officeCode = e.officeCode WHERE c.city = 'NYC'
SELECT SUM(od.quantityOrdered), AVG(od.priceEach) FROM orderdetails od JOIN products p ON p.productCode = od.productCode WHERE p.productName = '18th Century Vintage Horse Carriage'
SELECT p.amount FROM payments p JOIN customers c ON c.customerNumber = p.customerNumber WHERE c.customerName = 'Petit Auto' AND p.paymentDate = '2004-08-09'
SELECT c.addressLine1, c.addressLine2 FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber WHERE o.orderNumber = 10383
SELECT e.email FROM customers c JOIN employees e ON c.salesRepEmployeeNumber = e.employeeNumber WHERE c.customerName = 'Dragon Souveniers, Ltd.'
SELECT (p.MSRP - od.priceEach) / p.MSRP FROM orderdetails od JOIN products p ON p.productCode = od.productCode WHERE od.productCode = 'S18_3482' AND od.orderNumber = 10108
SELECT c.customerName FROM customers c JOIN employees e ON c.salesRepEmployeeNumber = e.employeeNumber WHERE e.firstName = 'Steve' AND e.lastName = 'Patterson'
SELECT o.addressLine1, o.addressLine2 FROM employees e JOIN offices o ON o.officeCode = e.officeCode WHERE e.jobTitle = 'President'

SELECT p.productName FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails od ON od.orderNumber = o.orderNumber JOIN products p ON p.productCode = od.productCode WHERE c.customerName = 'Cruz & Sons Co.' AND o.orderDate = '2003-03-03'
SELECT o.shippedDate FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber WHERE c.customerName = 'Cruz & Sons Co.' AND o.orderDate = '2003-03-03'
SELECT COUNT(o.customerNumber) FROM orders o JOIN orderdetails od ON od.orderNumber = o.orderNumber JOIN products p ON p.productCode = od.productCode WHERE p.productName = '1957 Chevy Pickup'
SELECT e.firstName, e.lastName FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber JOIN employees e ON c.salesRepEmployeeNumber = e.employeeNumber WHERE o.status = 'Disputed'
SELECT p.productName FROM products p JOIN orderdetails od ON od.productCode = p.productCode ORDER BY od.priceEach DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT contactFirstName, contactLastName FROM customers WHERE salesRepEmployeeNumber = 1370 ORDER BY creditLimit DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT p.productName, SUM(od.quantityOrdered) FROM orders o JOIN orderdetails od ON od.orderNumber = o.orderNumber JOIN products p ON p.productCode = od.productCode WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', o.orderDate) = '2003' GROUP BY p.productCode, p.productName ORDER BY SUM(od.quantityOrdered) DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT DISTINCT c.customerName FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber WHERE o.status = 'Disputed'
